pairs.summary: Atf1 and HIF1A motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 10 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; ...). Median lift 1.52x, typical spacing ~56 bp between sites. In 7 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
